objective: 在TP/PP已达标、PD总量已达标但12-bin形状仍未达标后，预注册地搜索shape-aware和multiplicative-bin residual predictor；OOF未达标就进入下一轮，只有完整合同通过才允许blind freeze。

dataset_contract.group_isolation: six model rows belonging to one profile stay in one fold
dataset_contract.final_input: low-dimensional causal profile, model structure, fixed P1/D1 execution features and H0 only

search_contract.runtime_policy: bounded below ten hours; no model_segment MLP expansion and no restoration of the old 144-candidate budget
search_contract.adaptive_signal: OOF-only per-bin signed bias, support mismatch, model/segment guard failures and multiplicative residual dispersion

predictor_contract.semantic: H0 plus target-free residual; TP/PP/PD execution configuration is input and placement/topology is not selected here
predictor_contract.new_hypothesis: predict log1p(target_bin)-log1p(H0_bin) per calls/bytes bin, then apply fit-fold support masks and H0-protected alpha
predictor_contract.support_rule: support masks are estimated only from fit-fold target rows and applied to held-out rows
predictor_contract.validation_rule: freeze candidate, round, alpha, support threshold, blend weights and epochs from OOF before opening validation once

acceptance_gate.oof_protection: overall and every model/segment strictly beat H0 on calls WAPE, bytes WAPE, calls TV and normalized payload EMD
acceptance_gate.model_histogram: each six-model row has calls and bytes histogram WAPE <= 0.15
acceptance_gate.segment_histogram: each BurstGPT segment has calls and bytes histogram WAPE <= 0.15 and composite ratio < 1
acceptance_gate.total_wape: overall calls and bytes total WAPE <= 0.05
acceptance_gate.next_phase_permitted: only when all OOF and one-shot validation gates pass
acceptance_gate.negative_policy: complete integrity with target_met=false is a valid negative result and blocks blind evaluation

stop_and_block_if: validation targets affect candidate or round selection
claim_boundary: development-only evidence on frozen Phase48 compact six-model data
not fresh blind evidence or Phase50 re-evaluation
not physical communication time, placement, latency, queueing, overlap or online scheduling
